01

Plan your day. Let your spending give back.

Find the suppliers you love and pay them through WedSparks. Every complete $10,000 spent through our payment function earns you $1,000 in wedding credits.

02

Every milestone makes a difference

Spend $10,000 through WedSparks payments to earn $1,000 in credits. Spend $20,000 to earn $2,000. At $25,000 of money paid, you have earned $2,000 and are $5,000 towards your next milestone. If an $11,000 payment includes $1,000 in credits, only the $10,000 paid with money counts.

03

Use your credits on your next wedding payment

Apply your available credits when making a payment through WedSparks. Credits can only be used through the WedSparks payment function; they cannot be withdrawn as cash or used for payments outside the platform.

04

Keep your budget and rewards connected

Your budget helps you track the whole wedding. Your credits are earned only on money paid through WedSparks payments. Amounts paid with credits do not earn further credits. Adding an expense or recording an outside payment in your budget does not earn credits.

A little more clarity

Can I withdraw the credits as cash?

No. Wedding credits can only be used through the WedSparks payment function towards supplier payments. They cannot be withdrawn as cash.

Does my whole wedding budget count?

Only money spent through the WedSparks payment function counts towards your credits. Payments made outside WedSparks and manually recorded expenses do not count.

Do payments made with credits earn more credits?

No. Only the money you pay through WedSparks counts towards your next milestone. The part covered by credits is excluded.

How do I earn and use my credits?

Pay your suppliers through WedSparks to earn $1,000 in credits for each complete $10,000 spent. Use your available credits when making another supplier payment through WedSparks.
